attire.notes:
We would love to see you in your finest formal attire as we celebrate our special day.

Ladies: Light Yellow | Pastel Yellow | Butter Yellow  
Gentlemen:Beige | Sand Beige | Light Brown

To complement our wedding theme, guests are encouraged to wear the suggested color palette and formal attire. Please refrain from wearing sneakers, slippers, denim, miniskirts, and T-shirts. As Barong Tagalog and Filipiniana are reserved for our wedding entourage, guests are requested to opt for other formal attire.

Thank you for being part of our special day. We can't wait to celebrate this beautiful moment with you!

faqs.question: Is parking available at the venues?
faqs.answer: Yes, parking is available at the venues. We recommend arriving early to allow ample time for parking and to settle in comfortably before the ceremony.

faqs.question: May I bring a plus-one?
faqs.answer: We regret that we are unable to accommodate additional guests, as our celebration is reserved exclusively for those personally invited. We sincerely appreciate your understanding as we celebrate this intimate and meaningful occasion.

faqs.question: Can I take photos during the ceremony?
faqs.answer: As our wedding ceremony will be held at the Iglesia Ni Cristo Church of Christ, we kindly ask everyone to respect the solemnity of the occasion by keeping their phones and other devices silenced and put away throughout the ceremony. We invite you to be fully present as we exchange our vows while our official photographer captures these precious moments. We’ll be happy to share the photos with you after the celebration. Thank you for your understanding and for helping us keep this special occasion solemn and meaningful.

faqs.question: Are children allowed?
faqs.answer: We love little ones! However, our wedding will be an adults-only celebration, except for children specifically included in the invitation. Thank you for understanding!

faqs.question: What time should I arrive?
faqs.answer: We kindly ask that you arrive at least 30 minutes before the ceremony begins to allow sufficient time for parking and seating. Your punctuality will help us begin the celebration as scheduled.

faqs.question: Who may I contact for questions or concerns?
faqs.answer: Feel free to reach out to the bride at 0955 608 5678 or our wedding coordinator, Donna Mae Tailan, at 0995 790 3026. We're happy to help!

faqs.question: When should I RSVP?
faqs.answer: Kindly send us your RSVP on or before December 20, 2026 so we can prepare everything with love and make your experience as comfortable as possible.

giftNote: Your presence on our special day is truly the greatest gift we could ask for. If you wish to bless us with a gift, a monetary gift would be greatly appreciated as we begin this new chapter together.

social.title: Capture the love
social.message: We’d love for you to capture and share your favorite moments from our special day. When posting on social media, don’t forget to use our wedding hashtag so we can cherish and relive these beautiful memories together.
